Log File Class

LogFile writes time-stamped lines to a file. WriteLine() is thread safe.

Contents

Overview
Functions

Overview

LogFile is built on std::ofstream. WriteLine() formats the time stamp, message and new line and writes them under a mutex, so several threads can share one log without mixing lines.

LogFile log;
log.Open("server.log");                 // Append, creating the file if needed
log.WriteLine("Server started on port 8443");
